hypotheses.D1_exact_component_recomposition: At every layer and corpus, carried-state, current embedding injection, attention-write, and MLP-write deltas exactly recompose the changed residual, and all-component hybrid logits match the residual-only intervention to at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.D2_some_attention_write_is_behaviorally_: At some layer on every corpus, attention receives at least 0.10 absolute within-residual Fisher Shapley projection.
hypotheses.D3_some_mlp_write_is_behaviorally_materi: At some layer on every corpus, the MLP receives at least 0.10 absolute within-residual Fisher Shapley projection.
hypotheses.D4_current_embedding_injection_is_locall: At some nonfinal layer on every corpus, the current block's embedding injection receives at least 0.10 absolute within-residual Shapley projection.
hypotheses.D5_late_residual_is_not_just_carried_sta: At Layer 10 on every corpus, attention plus MLP receive at least 0.10 absolute within-residual Shapley projection.
hypotheses.D6_component_depth_order_transfers_ood: The identity of the largest non-carried component at every layer is the same on FineWeb, WikiText, and TinyStories.
hypotheses.D7_state_energy_is_not_behavioral_credit: At some layer and corpus, a component's Euclidean state projection and within-residual behavioral Shapley projection differ by at least 0.15.
hypotheses.D8_attention_is_not_the_dominant_noncarr: The MLP has greater within-residual Shapley projection than attention at at least eight of twelve layers on every corpus.
